versions.changelog: - Restored full Jellyfin 10.11.x feature parity: the project now builds from a single dual-targeted csproj (net9.0 for the 10.11.0.0 ABI, net10.0 for the 12.0.0.0 ABI) instead of the 10.11.x line being frozen at the original fork's feature set. Every feature added since the Jellyfin 12 port (Channels admin actions, the Configuration/Status page split, HTSP reliability fixes, the channel-drop fixes) now ships for both server lines from the same commit. Published as 2.4.3.0 (net10.0/12.0.0.0 ABI) and 1.1.0.0 (net9.0/10.11.0.0 ABI).

- Restored full Jellyfin 10.11.x feature parity: the project now builds from a single dual-targeted csproj (net9.0 for the 10.11.0.0 ABI, net10.0 for the 12.0.0.0 ABI) instead of the 10.11.x line being frozen at the original fork's feature set. Every feature added since the Jellyfin 12 port (Channels admin actions, the Configuration/Status page split, HTSP reliability fixes, the channel-drop fixes) now ships for this line too. Published as 1.1.0.0 (net9.0/10.11.0.0 ABI) and 2.4.3.0 (net10.0/12.0.0.0 ABI).
